PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (11.0, 8.0, 16.0),      # input pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # input pair L (noise/gain)
    "itail": (80e-6, 40e-6, 160e-6),
    "gmid4": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS load / M7 gm/Id (same Vsg -> low offset)
    "L4":    (0.5, 0.35, 1.0),
    "i7":    (200e-6, 120e-6, 350e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS mirror L
    "gbw_t": (30e6, 20e6, 45e6),     # design GBW
    "rz_k":  (1.0, 0.6, 1.6),        # Rz scale vs. zero-on-p2 value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    it, i7 = p["itail"], p["i7"]
    gmid_n = 12.0

    # devices
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], it / 2, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], it / 2, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid4"], p["L4"], i7, vds=0.9)
    mb = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.6)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], it, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmid_n, p["Ln"], i7, vds=0.9)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["gbw_t"])
    c1 = m7.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m7.cgd * 0  # stage-1 output cap
    rz = p["rz_k"] * (1 + (cl + c1) / cc) / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    # bias: ibias sunk by diode nfet
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # input pair: M1 (vinp) drives o1; M2 (vinn) on diode side x
    n.dev("M1", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    # second stage
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    # compensation
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "z", rz)
    n.C("CC", "z", "vout", cc)

    # predictions
    a1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    a2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(a1 * a2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cc)
    p2 = m7.gm * cc / (2 * PI * (c1 * cl + cc * (c1 + cl)))
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd))
    # residual zero after Rz (LHP if rz > 1/gm7*(1+..))
    denom = cc * (1 / m7.gm - rz)
    zr = 1 / (2 * PI * denom) if abs(denom) > 1e-30 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / zr))
    pm += 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir))  # mirror pole-zero doublet
    slew = min(it / cc, i7 / (cl + cc))
    settle = 0.5 / slew + 4.6 / (2 * PI * ugbw * 0.8)
    power = 1.8 * (iref + it + i7)
    swing = 1.8 - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.1
    cmrr_db = db(a1 * 2 * m1.gm / (m5.gds + 1e-12) / max(a1, 1) * (m3.gm / m1.gm)) if m5.gds > 0 else 80
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    vn_th = math.sqrt(2 * 4 * 1.38e-23 * 300 * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th * 8  # flicker-dominated estimate

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "settle": settle, "swing": swing,
               "cmrr_db": cmrr_db, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
